title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT CHECK-IN
description: The change is pitched as onboarding, but it quietly rewires what the team thinks a beginner is worth. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.

title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT BREATHER
description: The update makes the game easier to explain from the outside, with consequences for those still inside. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. Daily chores have been shortened so players can leave before the evening becomes a second job.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. Engagement dipped, but so did the farewell essays.

title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH CHECK-IN
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.
